description: Source code for Zephyr-based MCUmgr image management, including flash operations, version comparison, slot management, and upload inspection.

methods.name: img_mgmt_flash_check_empty_inner
methods.description: Checks if a flash area is completely unwritten.

methods.name: img_mgmt_flash_check_empty
methods.description: Checks if a flash area identified by ID is empty (conditional on configuration).

methods.name: img_mgmt_flash_area_id
methods.description: Returns the flash area ID for a given slot number.

methods.name: img_mgmt_get_unused_slot_area_id
methods.description: Selects an unused slot area ID based on current usage and configuration.

methods.name: img_mgmt_erase_slot
methods.description: Erases the flash area corresponding to a slot.

methods.name: img_mgmt_write_pending
methods.description: Marks a slot for upgrade as pending.

methods.name: img_mgmt_read
methods.description: Reads data from a slot at a specified offset.

methods.name: img_mgmt_write_image_data
methods.description: Writes image data to flash, with heap management depending on configuration.

methods.name: img_mgmt_erase_image_data
methods.description: Erases image data in a slot.

methods.name: img_mgmt_swap_type
methods.description: Returns the swap type for a slot.

methods.name: img_mgmt_upload_inspect
methods.description: Inspects an upload request to determine actions and validate.

methods.name: img_mgmt_erased_val
methods.description: Retrieves the erased value of a slot.
